t: What Semi-Sync Replication Internals Is All About
title: What Semi-Sync Replication Internals Is All About
description: MySQL's middle path: wait for at least one replica before acknowledging.. This database covers Semi-Sync Replication Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Replication is copying data for durability, availability, or scale.
definition: Semi-Sync Replication Internals — MySQL's middle path: wait for at least one replica before acknowledging.
key_points: Replication is copying data for durability, availability, or scale.
Leader-follower is the default; simple to reason about.
Synchronous replication is safe but slow; asynchronous is fast but lossy.
Semi-sync is the pragmatic middle.

Create replication slots; monitor them.
Configure synchronous commit per durability needs.
